sign_in.fallback_authentication_failed: Authentication failed. Check your account and password and try again.

mcp_oauth.title: Authorize MCP connection
mcp_oauth.introduction: Verify and authorize with an API key. No 1flowbase console sign-in is required.
mcp_oauth.request_error: This authorization request is invalid or expired. Return to ChatGPT and reconnect.
mcp_oauth.key_error: Unable to verify this API key. Check its expiry, workspace and MCP permissions, then enter it again.
mcp_oauth.decision_error: Authorization could not be completed. Verify your API key again, or reconnect from ChatGPT if the request has expired.
mcp_oauth.permission_notice: Allow this client to call tools through this MCP instance within the API key’s current permissions.
mcp_oauth.lifecycle_notice: The connection can refresh automatically for up to 30 days per authorization. Reauthorize when authorization or the API key expires, or the key is revoked.
mcp_oauth.key_help: Your key is submitted only to 1flowbase for verification. It is never sent to ChatGPT.

external_auth.registration_disabled: New registrations are disabled for this sign-in method. Sign in to your existing account, then link GitHub in your profile.
external_auth.account_too_new: Your GitHub account does not meet this site’s minimum account age.
external_auth.email_required: Registration requires a verified primary email on GitHub. Verify your email on GitHub first.
external_auth.identity_exists: This email or GitHub identity is already associated with an account. Sign in to that account before linking GitHub.
external_auth.registration_ineligible: Your GitHub account does not currently meet this site’s registration requirements.
external_auth.cancelled: GitHub authorization was cancelled. You can try again.
external_auth.invalid_state: This sign-in request has expired or was already used. Start again.
external_auth.entry_unavailable: This sign-in entry is disabled. Choose another method.
external_auth.provider_unavailable: GitHub sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or choose another method.
external_auth.session_expired: Your session expired while linking GitHub. Sign in again before retrying.
external_auth.user_disabled: This local account is disabled. Contact your administrator.
external_auth.failed: GitHub sign-in did not complete. Try again or choose another method.
external_auth.identity_unlinked: This GitHub identity was unlinked. Sign in to its original local account using another method, then restore it in Personal information → Security settings → GitHub. A new account will not be created.
